summary: Russian forces launched a massive wave of reactive Shahed drones and missiles across multiple Ukrainian cities, causing significant civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. Strikes on Kyiv data centers disrupted national television broadcasting, while Russian forces claimed advances in the Kharkiv and Sum regions. US President Trump renewed calls for a peace deal between Zelensky and Putin amid reports of high monthly casualty figures.
key_points: Russian forces launched a massive wave of reactive Shahed drones and missiles across Ukraine, targeting Kyiv, Sum, Zaporizhzhia, and other regions, causing civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. (Source: @UkraineNow/84315, @mon1tor_ua/75764)
Strikes on data centers in Kyiv caused temporary suspension of several Ukrainian TV channels, including "News LIVE" and "We are Ukraine+". (Source: @UkraineNow/84319, @UkraineNow/84325)
Russian forces claimed control over Petropavlovka and Lozova in Kharkiv region, and Maryino in Sum region. (Source: @tass_agency/397499)
Ukraine intercepts 55% of reactive Shaheds and over 90% of conventional ones, while Russia plans to spend $12 billion on drone production in 2027. (Source: @UkraineNow/84324)
US President Trump urged Zelensky and Putin to reach a deal, noting 25,000 deaths in the past month. (Source: @UkraineNow/84320, @ukr_leaks_eng/33545)
Russian drones are equipped with thermal imaging cameras to target mini-power plants in Ukraine during winter. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33531)
Russian forces struck the center of Sum with three KABs, killing two and injuring six, including a child. (Source: @UkraineNow/84315)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces launched a massive wave of reactive Shahed drones and missiles across multiple Ukrainian cities, causing significant civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. Strikes on Kyiv data centers disrupted national television broadcasting, while Russian forces claimed advances in the Kharkiv and Sum regions. US President Trump renewed calls for a peace deal between Zelensky and Putin amid reports of high monthly casualty figures.

points: Civilian infrastructure heavily targeted: Multi-story buildings, an ATB store, and a railway station were hit in Kyiv (Solomianskyi, Shuliavka, Lukyanivka, Vatslava Havel Blvd). (Source: @UkraineNow/84303, @mon1tor_ua/75764, @mon1tor_ua/75772, @mon1tor_ua/75763)
Data center strikes disrupted broadcasting: Multiple TV channels suspended operations due to strikes on telecom infrastructure in Kyiv. (Source: @UkraineNow/84319, @UkraineNow/84325)
Sumy region suffered a triple KAB strike: 2 dead, 6 injured including a child; Zaporizhzhia saw a building hit killing a mother and grandmother. (Source: @UkraineNow/84315)
Air defense active: Ukraine intercepts a significant portion of Shahed drones, though reactive variants pose a higher challenge. (Source: @UkraineNow/84324)
Knife attack on military TCC worker in Bilhorod-Dnistrovskyi; veteran hospitalized. (Source: @UkraineNow/84322)
Massive drone and missile production/expansion: Plans to allocate $12 billion in 2027 for reactive drones and loitering munitions. (Source: @UkraineNow/84324)
Military advances claimed: Control established over Petropavlovka, Lozova (Kharkiv region), and Maryino (Sum region). (Source: @tass_agency/397499)
Information warfare/disinformation: Claims of striking 25% of Ukrainian internet/Starlink infrastructure. (Source: @tass_agency/397521)
Diplomatic posture: Lavrov asserts security threats from Kyiv will be eliminated and meets with German FM after 4.5 years. (Source: @tass_agency/397497, @tass_agency/397499)
Russian forces advanced or consolidated positions in Kharkiv (Petropavlovka, Lozova) and Sum (Maryino) regions. (Source: @tass_agency/397499)
Dnipropetrovsk region saw drone activity: Conventional and reactive UAVs moving north from Kryvyi Rih, and reactive ones from Donbas. (Source: @eRadarrua/117315, @eRadarrua/117291)
Cherkasy region had reactive UAVs heading towards Monastyrshche from the south. (Source: @kpszsu/80449)
Sumy region under drone surveillance and attacks: Reactive UAVs repeating courses via Shostka. (Source: @eRadarrua/117353, @eRadarrua/117312)
Civilian targets hit in Sumy center with KABs. (Source: @UkraineNow/84315)
Chernihiv and Sumy regions are launchpads for reactive UAVs targeting Kyiv and the Kyiv reservoir. (Source: @kpszsu/80477, @eRadarrua/117353)
Zhytomyr region (Berdychiv) targeted by reactive Shaheds. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75758)

Kyiv region under constant drone threat: Multiple reactive UAVs and Shaheds intercepted or hitting areas like Brovary, Vasylkiv, Irpin, and Zhuliany. (Source: @kpszsu/80479, @mon1tor_ua/75773, @kpszsu/80446)
Possible train hit on the border of Vinnytsia and Zhytomyr regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75759)
Mykolaiv targeted by reactive UAVs from the Black Sea and land routes. (Source: @kpszsu/80448, @mon1tor_ua/75742)
Odesa region saw a UAV group heading towards Izmail and Katlabuh. (Source: @kpszsu/80454)
Zaporizhzhia region suffered civilian casualties from a building strike. (Source: @UkraineNow/84315)
Oleksandriia and Uman (Cherkasy region, but southern axis) targeted by Shaheds. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75770, @mon1tor_ua/75768)
